info.title: Records Service API
info.description: Manages record configurations (schemas) and the records that conform to them. Record IDs are server-generated; config IDs are client-supplied (^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$). Configs and records are updated with PUT (partial: config update applies only the fields sent; record update merges `data`). Editing a config schema does not retroactively re-validate existing records. The engine also exposes a records-count-by-config capability (records-per-config counts) that currently has no public REST route.

get.description: Returns all record configurations in the account. Each configuration defines the schema (field names, types, validation rules) and UI hints for a category of records. Call this first to discover available record types before listing or querying records. Pass `ids` to batch-fetch specific configurations instead of all.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated config IDs to fetch a specific subset. Omit to return all configurations.

post.description: Defines a new category of records by specifying a schema (field names, types, validation constraints) and UI rendering hints. The `id` you choose becomes the `config_id` used in all subsequent record operations for this type. Returns 409 if a configuration with the same ID already exists.

400.description: Validation error (invalid ID format, invalid schema, missing required fields)

409.description: A record configuration with the given ID already exists

get.description: Retrieves the full schema and UI layout for a specific record configuration. Use this to inspect field definitions and validation rules before creating or updating records of that type.

put.description: Updates a record configuration. Schema changes do not retroactively affect existing records.

delete.description: Deletes the configuration and its associated records storage bucket.

get.description: Search for records across a folder or space (index-backed). At least one of `folder` or `space_id` must be provided, and a Bearer JWT is required (used to derive the tenant) — an API key alone is rejected on this endpoint. `folder`/`space_id` conditions are ANDed. Results are sorted by `created_at`.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder ID to filter records by. At least one of `folder` or `space_id` must be provided.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Space ID to filter records by. At least one of `folder` or `space_id` must be provided.

parameters.name: config_id
parameters.description: Comma-separated config IDs to narrow the query. One ID is ANDed with the folder/space filter; multiple IDs form an OR group.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

400.description: Missing required filter parameter or invalid authorization token

404.description: No records found matching the query

parameters.name: config_id
parameters.description: ID of the record configuration that records belong to

get.description: Returns all records that belong to the given configuration. Use this to retrieve every data entry for a specific record type. For filtered or cross-type queries, use GET /records instead.

200.description: List of records for the given configuration

post.description: Creates a new record conforming to the specified configuration's schema. Record data is validated against the schema at creation time.

400.description: Validation error (missing required fields, type mismatch, invalid dropdown value)

parameters.name: config_id
parameters.description: ID of the record configuration that the record belongs to

get.description: Retrieves a single record by its ID within a given configuration. Returns the full data object and metadata (id, created_at, updated_at). Obtain the record ID from a list or query operation first.

put.description: Updates a record. Provided data fields are merged into the existing record data. The merged result is validated against the current schema.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a single record by its ID. This action is irreversible — the record's data and metadata are removed. The configuration and all other records are unaffected.

RecordPropType.description: Allowed JSON primitive/composite types for a schema field.

FormatterType.description: Display formatter applied when rendering a field value.

FieldProps.description: Display / configuration props forwarded to the input widget. `label` should always be set. Which props apply depends on the input type (e.g. `options`/`sort` for dropdown, `min`/`max`/`decimalPlace` for number/currency, `minDate`/`maxDate` for date, `includedCountries`/`showNativeName` for country, `maxItems` for multi-select).

label.description: Display label shown above/beside the input. Always set this.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown inside the input when empty.

helpText.description: Optional help text rendered below the input.

markdown.description: Help text content in Markdown format.

options.description: Choices for dropdown / multi-select / multi-toggle. Seed from the schema field's enum.

value.description: Machine value submitted when this option is selected.

note.description: Optional extra description shown alongside the option.

sort.description: When `true`, options are sorted alphabetically before rendering.

minDate.description: Earliest selectable date (ISO 8601). Applies to `date` / `date-range` inputs.

maxDate.description: Latest selectable date (ISO 8601). Applies to `date` / `date-range` inputs.

min.description: Minimum allowed numeric value. Applies to `number` / `currency` / `slider` inputs.

max.description: Maximum allowed numeric value. Applies to `number` / `currency` / `slider` inputs.

decimalPlace.description: Number of decimal places displayed. Applies to `number` / `currency` inputs.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of selections. Applies to `multi-select`.

includedCountries.description: Restrict the country list to these ISO codes (e.g. ["uk","ua"]). Applies to `country` / `multi-country`.

showNativeName.description: Show each country's native name. Applies to `country` / `multi-country`.

FieldUi.description: LEGACY per-schema-field renderer hint. The current model places `inputType`/`props` on the view field node instead (see ViewFieldNode); the renderer reads node config first and only falls back to this schema-level `ui` for nested object-group members and array-item leaves that are not their own view node, and the frontend strips `ui` from placed fields on save. Prefer node-level config.

FieldFormatter.description: Formatter applied when displaying a field value.

props.description: Extra props forwarded to the formatter.

FieldDisplay.description: Display configuration embedded in a schema field.

RecordSchemaField.description: Definition of a single field at any depth of the schema tree. Recurses via `properties` (objects) and `items` (arrays). Only `type` is required. Input config for a placed form field belongs on the view node (ViewFieldNode.inputType/props), NOT here; the legacy `ui` hint is a fallback only.

type.description: JSON type(s) for this field. Use an array to allow multiple types (e.g. ["string", "null"]).

properties.description: Nested field definitions for object-typed fields.

required.description: Names of required nested fields. Only meaningful when `type` is "object".

ui.description: LEGACY UI fallback (not standard JSON Schema). Prefer node-level inputType/props on the view field node; this is only read for descendants that are not their own view node and is stripped from placed fields on save.

RecordSchema.description: A JSON Schema document describing the record structure. Always a top-level object. UI and display hints (`ui`, `display`) are embedded directly in each field definition.

type.description: Must be "object" — a record schema always describes a top-level object.

properties.description: Top-level field definitions keyed by field name.

gap.description: Gap between grid cells in pixels.

RuleProperty.description: The element property a rule drives. Field nodes support all five; grid (container) nodes support `visible` only.

ElementRule.description: A conditional rule attached to a view node. `logic` is a json-logic-engine expression evaluated against the live form value ({ "var": "FieldPath" } reads another field; dotted paths allowed); at the form root it reads the whole record, inside an array-field item it reads that item. `logic` may also be a bare boolean for an unconditional state. The result sets `property` (booleans are coerced; `value` keeps the raw computed value).

logic.description: A json-logic-engine expression object, or a boolean.

description.description: One plain-English sentence describing the condition and outcome. Does not affect evaluation.

ViewGridNode.description: A grid layout container that arranges child nodes in CSS grid columns.

rules.description: Conditional rules for this container. Only the `visible` property is honoured on a grid.

ViewFieldNode.description: A leaf node that binds an input to a schema field via a dotted path. Input config lives HERE on the node — `inputType`, `props`, and `rules` — not on the schema, so one schema can back several forms with different config. Omit `inputType` to accept the type default (string→text, number/integer→number, boolean→toggle, array→tags, object→key-value).

field.description: Dotted path to the schema field (e.g. "name", "address.city"). The property key is `field` (a `ref` key is ignored by the engine).

rules.description: Conditional rules for this field. Field nodes support all five rule properties.

ViewTableColumn.description: A column descriptor in a table view.

field.description: Schema field key this column displays.

ViewTableNode.description: A table view that lists columns to display and their order.

ViewArrayFieldNode.description: A repeating container (Repeater) bound to an array-of-object schema field. `children` is a builder-authored template of view nodes for one item; each child's `field` is ELEMENT-RELATIVE — resolved against the array field's `items.properties`, not the top-level schema (e.g. for array field "products", a child field "title" means "products[].title", not "products.title"). `props` (label, required, minItems, maxItems, collapsible, defaultCollapsed) is UI-only and not enforced by records-service; array size limits still come from the schema field's own JSON Schema minItems/maxItems if set there.

field.description: Dotted path to an array-of-object schema field.

props.description: UI-only container config: label, required (at least one item), minItems, maxItems, collapsible, defaultCollapsed.

children.description: View nodes for one item, with element-relative `field` refs. Child field nodes carry their own node-level inputType/props/rules.

rules.description: Reserved — array-field rules are NOT evaluated in v1. Put rules on the child field nodes instead.

ViewNode.description: A node in the view tree — a grid container, a field leaf, an array-field repeater, or a table.

RecordForm.description: One named form for a config: metadata plus a grid layout tree. `id` is unique within the config and appears in the app URL; the migrated legacy single form always gets id "default".

RecordViews.description: UI layout definitions for different rendering contexts. `forms` (multiple named forms) is the current model. `form` (singular) is the deprecated legacy single form — the server still accepts it, but the frontend migrates it to `forms: [{ id: "default", ... }]` on read and never writes it back.

forms.description: Current model — multiple named forms per config.

form.description: Deprecated legacy single form. Use `forms` instead.

id.description: Unique identifier. Immutable after creation. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen.

description.description: Optional longer description of what this configuration represents.

label.description: Optional short label, e.g. for UI badges or tabs.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp set automatically on creation.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp updated automatically on every modification.

InputType.description: Input widget type for form rendering.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must be unique across all configurations. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen.

rules.description: A comment is required when the rating is 2 or lower.

RecordConfigUpdate.description: All fields are optional. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Schema changes do not retroactively affect existing records.

id.description: Unique identifier. Auto-generated if not provided on creation.

config_id.description: ID of the RecordConfig that defines this record's schema.

data.description: Key-value map of field values. Keys correspond to SchemaField IDs. Values must match the field type defined in the schema. Extra keys not defined in the schema are permitted.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp set automatically on creation.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp updated automatically on every modification.

RecordCreate.description: The config_id is taken from the URL path and does not need to be repeated in the body. `data` is optional (defaults to an empty object) but is validated against the config schema when present.

id.description: Server-generated record ID (10-character nanoid). Any `id` sent in the request body is ignored.

data.description: Field values validated against the configuration schema. Required schema fields must be present. Values are type-checked against the schema. Null values are accepted for optional fields. Extra keys not in the schema are allowed. If omitted, an empty object is used.

space_id.description: Optional space ID to associate the record with a specific space.

folder.description: Optional folder to organize the record into.

RecordUpdate.description: Partial update. `data` is merged key-by-key into the existing record; `folder`/`space_id` are overwritten only when supplied. The merged result is validated against the current schema.

data.description: Fields to update. Merged into the existing record data (partial update). The merged result is validated against the current schema.

space_id.description: Optional space ID to associate the record with a specific space.

folder.description: Optional folder to organize the record into.

results_total.description: Number of records returned in this response.

total_hits.description: Total matching records across all pages (returned by the query endpoint; used with limit/offset).

status_code.description: HTTP status code echoed in the response body.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme

tags.name: Record Configs
tags.description: Manage record configuration schemas. Each configuration defines the structure (fields, types, validation rules) that records must conform to.

tags.name: Records
tags.description: Manage individual data records. Each record belongs to exactly one configuration and its data is validated against that configuration's schema.
